replacements.VQ-VAE convierte imágenes en tokens disc: VQ-VAE converts images into discrete tokens. Mixture of Experts activates only the parameters relevant to each modality. Together they make native tokenization viable at massive scale.
replacements.Imagen continua en espacio de píxeles. N: A continuous image in pixel space. It cannot be mixed directly with text tokens.
replacements.Cada patch de la imagen se proyecta a un: Each image patch is projected into a high-dimensional continuous vector.
replacements.El vector continuo se mapea al código di: The continuous vector is mapped to the nearest discrete code in the learned codebook (8192 entries in VQGAN).
replacements.tokens de imagen · tokens de texto · pro: image tokens · text tokens · processed together
replacements.Los índices discretos ocupan el mismo es: The discrete indices occupy the same token space as text. The transformer processes them without distinguishing modality.
replacements.Imagen → encoder visual continuo → conec: Image → continuous visual encoder → connector → LLM. The image is never a token; it always requires an adaptation module.
replacements.Imagen → VQ-VAE → índices → mismo transf: Image → VQ-VAE → indices → the same transformer as text. No connector, no separate module. A single heterogeneous sequence.
replacements.Para cada token, el router calcula una d: For each token, the router computes a probability distribution over experts and selects the top-k (typically k=2).
replacements.Especializado en patches de imagen. Pará: Specialized in image patches. Parameters tuned during visual pretraining.
replacements.Especializado en tokens de texto. Paráme: Specialized in text tokens. Parameters tuned during text pretraining.
replacements.No recibe tokens en esta inferencia. Sus: It receives no tokens in this inference. Its parameters are neither computed nor updated in the forward pass.
replacements.Disponible pero no seleccionado. El mode: Available but not selected. The model has latent capacity without inference cost.
replacements.Por qué MoE cambia el análisis de coste: Why MoE changes the cost analysis
replacements.Un modelo denso con N parámetros activa: A dense model with N parameters activates all N on every forward pass. An MoE with N total parameters activates only N/k per token. Inference cost scales with active parameters, not total parameters: model capacity is larger than the cost suggests.
